tier1.headline: Your data shared for ads.
tier1.quote: We may share limited categories of personal data (online identifiers and product-related information used to display appropriate ads) with these third parties for cross-contextual advertising purposes, as defined under California and other applicable U.S. state laws.

tier1.headline: Your data trains AI models.
tier1.quote: We analyze samples of files and URLs we detect on your devices or websites you visit, and we use them to maintain our malware and privacy protection at the highest level possible.

tier1.headline: Your payment details are collected.
tier1.quote: Billing data includes your name, email address, billing address, your phone number, payment information (depending on method can include Credit/Debit Card Information or PayPal account), National ID (regional specific, if outside the United States), VAT/Tax ID (regional specific, if outside the United States) and device fingerprint ID.

tier2.headline: Your data shared across family.
tier2.quote: We only disclose your Personal Data as described below, within our group of companies, with our partners, with service providers that process data on our behalf and with public authorities, when required by applicable law.

tier2.headline: Your product data kept for years.
tier2.quote: The rolling deletion periods for Product Data are not longer than six years.

tier2.headline: Your device location is collected.
tier2.quote: Device Data includes information about the operating system; hardware; city/country location of device; IP address, device error logs; browser; network; applications running on the device, including the Avast products.

tier2.headline: Your behavior is used for profiling.
tier2.quote: We use relevant Billing Data, Account Data, Product Data and your answers from surveys, in which you can participate, to personalize our offers, communication and product recommendations.

tier2.headline: Your data used for targeted ads.
tier2.quote: To enable the provision of personalized ads in support of certain free products.

tier2.headline: Your data transferred globally.
tier2.quote: The servers that are part of this infrastructure may therefore be located in a country different than the one where you live.

tier2.headline: Your data shared with authorities.
tier2.quote: In certain instances, it may be necessary for us to disclose your Personal Data to public authorities or as otherwise required by applicable law.

tier2.headline: Your deletion rights are limited.
tier2.quote: You have the right to erasure of your Personal Data, but only in specific cases stipulated by law, e.g., if there is no legally recognized title on our part for further processing of your Personal Data (incl. protection of our legitimate interests and rights).
